title: Need tester for FREE A.I. powered charting Engine
author: Old-Reception7469
selftext:
Hi all, I'm Leon founder of Contrary Trader.

 I created an A.I powered engine that does chart-pattern analysis across timeframes, with trade setups and a weekly earnings and economic catalyst calendar

I'm looking for a small group of people to test  something I built for free, in exchange for honest feedback. Specifically, I'd like to know:

Is the chart breakdown clear and useful?

Is the setup format easy to follow?

What's missing or confusing?

If you're interested, comment below or message me and I'll send access details. Free access doesn't include any obligation to buy anything later.

Important: Contrary Trader is educational analysis, not financial advice. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell any security, and trading carries risk of loss. Please do your own research.

Sign up here. Contrarytrader.com

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
the setup format matters less than the receipts. what would sell me is every setup the engine ever called, timestamped before the move, with how many hit target before stop. without that log a tester can only tell you it looks nice.

I built Quantradin (quantradin.com), free with no real money in it, and it takes a setup written as a rule and runs it across years of real prices, so you get exactly that count. are your setups tight enough to write down as a rule?
